subject: general
question: Who among the following is associated with the Theosophical Society?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant** was a prominent British socialist, theosophist, women's rights activist, writer, orator, and supporter of Indian and Irish self-rule.
 
• She was associated with the **Theosophical Society**, an organization formed in **1875 **to advance theosophy, a spiritual movement.
 
• Annie Besant became the president of the Theosophical Society in 1907 and played a significant role in its activities.
 
• She was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and founded the Home Rule League, advocating for self-governance for India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tarabai Shinde** was a feminist and writer known for her work** "Stri Purush Tulana," **a critique of the treatment of women in society.
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was an Indian independence activist, poet, and politician who was also the first woman to become the president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Savitri Bai Phule** was a social reformer and educationalist who played a crucial role in improving women's rights and education in India.
 
• The **Theosophical Society** was instrumental in promoting spiritual and philosophical ideas and had a significant influence on various reform movements in India.
